name: treeData
description: 节点数据，value 必须全树唯一；以新数组更新结构

name: expandedKeys
description: 受控展开键

name: defaultExpandedKeys
description: 初始展开键

name: defaultExpandAll
description: 仅创建时展开已有分支

name: selectedKeys
description: 受控行选中键

name: defaultSelectedKeys
description: 初始行选中键

name: checkedKeys
description: 受控复选键

name: defaultCheckedKeys
description: 初始复选键

name: checkable
description: 传 checkedKeys/defaultCheckedKeys 时自动开启，否则关闭；显式 false 优先

name: selectable
description: 是否允许选中行

name: multiple
description: 行选择允许多选，点击切换，不需要 Ctrl

name: checkStrictly
description: 父子复选独立，不计算半选

name: disabled
description: 整体禁用，仍显示已有展开与选择

name: onExpand
description: 展开/收起请求

name: onSelect
description: 行选择请求

name: onCheck
description: 复选请求；keys 为联动计算后的全部键

name: draggable
description: 启用原生 HTML5 拖拽；禁用节点不能拖动

name: allowDrop
description: 返回 false 拒绝目标；不会绕过禁用和防环规则

name: onDragStart / onDragEnter / onDragOver / onDragLeave / onDragEnd
description: 拖拽生命周期；结束后清除悬停与计时器

name: onDrop
description: 报告拖放，不自动修改数据

name: showLine
description: 非虚拟树显示父子连接线

name: showIcon
description: 显示默认或自定义图标

name: indent
description: 每层缩进，px

name: showSearch
description: 显示搜索输入框

name: searchValue
description: 受控搜索内容；即使不展示输入框也能过滤

name: onSearch
description: 输入搜索请求

name: searchPlaceholder
description: 搜索框提示

name: titleRender
description: 自定义节点内容；ARIA 名称仍使用 label

name: icon
description: showIcon 开启时的自定义图标

name: notFoundContent
description: 无节点或无匹配时展示

name: aria-label
description: 树容器可访问名称

name: class
description: 外层容器类

name: style
description: 外层容器样式

name: ref
description: 外层 div，不是 TreeIns
